# Markdown Preview Pro

> A clean, minimal markdown preview extension for Visual Studio Code with syntax highlighting, Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math rendering, HTML/PDF export, and interactive features.

## Key Links

- Landing Page: https://luongnv.com/vscode-markdown-preview/
- VS Code Marketplace: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=luongnv89.markdown-preview-pro
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/luongnv89/vscode-markdown-preview
- User Guide: https://github.com/luongnv89/vscode-markdown-preview/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md

## Features

- Syntax-highlighted code blocks with copy button
- Mermaid diagram rendering (flowcharts, sequence diagrams, etc.)
- KaTeX math rendering (inline and block)
- Interactive task list checkboxes
- YAML frontmatter displayed as styled metadata card
- Export to standalone HTML
- Export to PDF (requires Chrome/Chromium)
- Bidirectional scroll sync between editor and preview
- Table of Contents sidebar
- Word count and reading stats
- Presentation/slide mode
- Dark and light theme toggle

## Installation

Install from VS Code Marketplace by searching "Markdown Preview Pro" or run:
```
code --install-extension luongnv89.markdown-preview-pro
```

Requires VS Code >= 1.85.0. PDF export requires Chrome or Chromium.
